exposure: Severe maternal morbidity (defined as ICU admission and/or transfusion of 4 or more units of packed red blood cells)
cohort: Pregnant women in Illinois from July 1, 2016, to June 30, 2017.
finding: Facility-level review of severe maternal morbidity cases (76 per 10,000 pregnancies) was feasible and acceptable, revealing hemorrhage as the primary cause (over 50% of cases) and highlighting the need for in-depth review to improve maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: More than half of the women who experienced severe maternal morbidity delivered by cesarean section.
